answer: Every claim climbs the oasis of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the island re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on invitation quota tree, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work. By the walnut of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
